Compression reduces size at cost of error. Track-specific error metric must match position/rotation/perception relevance.
Key reduction and quantization with bounds; cache evaluated data using full dependencies.
Compressed angles wrap incorrectly; stale cached pose.
Maximum error across intervals, contact-critical frames, cache invalidation.
Ownership events dan lifecycle
Animation events and callbacks have time-crossing semantics. Seek, reverse and cancellation require defined event policy and cleanup.
One owner per property or explicit composition; generation token rejects stale completions.
Event fired twice after seek; unmounted target callback.
Forward/reverse/seek/cancel histories, resource cleanup and final state.
worked: Contoh walking lower-body clip plus upper-body pointing. Mask pointing to torso/arm, maintain locomotion root from base. Additive breathing layer uses known reference pose; full-body replacement would erase walk. At transition to idle, decide whether pointer action persists or fades. Record policy and test repeated navigation/state changes rather than only smooth forward playback.
workflow: Define channel schema/base pose; normalize time; implement pure evaluator; add composition; define event policy; compress with error bounds; test layered and interrupted playback.
mastery: Dapat membangun clip evaluator, masks, additive layers dan phase-aware transitions; membuktikan lifecycle cleanup.
advanced: Nonlinear animation; pose graphs; blend-space interpolation; motion compression; animation streaming; motion matching integration; multirate animation evaluation.

title: State Event and Reactive Motion Architecture
purpose: Membuat motion menjadi respons sistem yang predictable terhadap state, events, asynchronous work, dan interruptions.
boundary: State architecture bukan motion model. Ia memilih goals dan lifecycle; evaluator D19 dan solver D10 menjalankan perubahan.
topics: Finite-state machines
Explicit states membatasi valid transitions. Animation phase dan business state dapat berbeda; completed animation tidak selalu berarti task success.
Transition table state×event→next state plus side effects; reject invalid events.
Implicit booleans allow impossible combinations.
Enumerate transitions, invalid events, terminal states and invariants.
Statecharts dan hierarchy
Hierarchy mengurangi duplicate transitions; parallel regions represent concurrent behavior. Entry/exit actions need deterministic semantics.
Parent/child active states with event priority and history policy.
Parent exit forgets child animation cleanup.
Nested transitions, simultaneous events and exit cleanup.
Signals dan reactive graphs
Derived motion values depend on sources; batching prevents intermediate inconsistent outputs. Cycles need rejection or explicit iterative semantics.
Dirty propagation, topological evaluation, one commit after transaction.
Glitches, repeated work, hidden cycle.
Diamond graph, batched changes, cycle fixture and consistent snapshots.
Interruption cancellation dan stale work
Cancel is lifecycle operation, not merely hide output. Pending async completions must not overwrite newer state.
Generation/version token; completion accepted only when owner/token current.
Old transition callback restores wrong visibility.
Rapid toggle, delayed completion and target removal tests.
Concurrency dan event ordering
Multiple input/network/animation events require priority and ordering policy. Wall-clock arrival order may differ logical sequence.
Queue events with source sequence/time; arbitrate ownership before output mutation.
Two loops update same transform; nondeterministic event race.
Permute independent events, reproduce conflict histories.
Observers dan resource lifecycle
Listeners, timers, observers and animation instances retain resources. Unmount/dispose must end ownership and subscriptions.
Create/dispose symmetry, cancellation on teardown, weak ownership where useful.
Memory leaks and duplicate handlers after remount.
Mount/unmount repeated, count resources, trigger events post-disposal.
Reactive goals versus presentation
Desired state differs from intermediate visual state. Store goals separately, derive motion, report interaction affordance promptly.
goal state→motion controller→presented state; preserve semantic accessibility while animating.
Slow visual exit delays actual disabled state; hidden target stays focusable.
Keyboard/focus tests and state checks during intermediate motion.
worked: Contoh drawer states closed/opening/open/closing. OPEN during closing retargets from current pose; a previous close-completion token must be ignored. Escape updates desired closed state immediately, and focus policy follows semantic state. Visual spring can continue while pointer interaction is disabled. Test event sequences such as OPEN,CLOSE,OPEN before any animation finishes.
workflow: Define semantic states; map valid events; separate desired/presented state; define ownership; add cancellation tokens; instrument transitions; replay adversarial histories.
mastery: Dapat merancang event histories tanpa impossible states dan membuktikan cleanup serta stale-callback rejection.
advanced: Actor models; event sourcing; distributed statecharts; functional reactive programming; hybrid systems; transactional reactive evaluation.

title: Input Gesture and Sensor Systems
purpose: Mengubah input perangkat menjadi events/gestures/state estimates dengan timestamps, coordinate frames dan cancellation yang jelas.
boundary: Acquisition/recognition berbeda dari interaction mapping D22. Input source tidak selalu pointer, dan gestures tidak boleh menghilangkan keyboard semantics.
topics: Pointer events dan capture
Mouse/touch/pen dapat dibungkus pointer model tetapi mempunyai capabilities berbeda. Capture menjaga routing saat pointer keluar target; cancellation tetap mungkin.
Track pointerId, initial position, capture lifecycle and pointercancel.
Drag stuck setelah OS cancels; pointer ownership overwritten.
Outside-target drag, cancellation, multi-pointer and capture-loss cases.
Coordinate mapping
Event client coordinates tidak selalu sama local geometry coordinates setelah transform, zoom atau scrolling.
Map client point through inverse relevant transform; distinguish CSS pixels and backing pixels.
High-DPI scale double applied; scroll offset stale.
Known points under scroll/zoom/transformed parent.
Gesture recognition
Swipe, pinch dan rotate memerlukan thresholds, simultaneity dan ambiguity handling. Early recognition trades responsiveness against false positives.
State machine possible→recognized/cancelled; derive scale/angle from consistent pointer pair.
Small jitter triggers swipe; recognizer steals native scroll.
Threshold boundaries, slow drag, fast swipe, pointer replacement.
Velocity estimation
Velocity dari last two samples peka noise dan coalesced events. Temporal window/filter harus mengakui delay dan irregular cadence.
Weighted fit or finite differences on actual timestamps; handle zero dt.
Release velocity based stale sample; enormous velocity after tiny dt.
Synthetic trajectories with irregular event times and noise.
Keyboard wheel dan discrete input
Wheel units/modes berbeda; keyboard repeats bukan physical motion samples. Commands perlu semantik dan focus ownership.
Normalize units cautiously; use intent commands then model motion.
Scroll hijack, repeated key starts competing animations.
Keyboard-only flow, different wheel modes, focus changes.
Inertial spatial dan fused sensors
Gyro, accelerometer dan orientation estimates memiliki units, frames, drift dan permissions. Gravity and linear acceleration need model separation.
Calibrate bias; timestamp data; fuse with explicit state/noise model if needed.
Gyro integrated without dt; gravity interpreted translation.
Stationary/known-rotation cases, missing samples, unit/frame conversions.
Capability permission dan degradation
Sensor availability, browser support dan permission affect path. Capability detection should be behavior-based, with alternative input.
Detect feature, request only needed access under platform rules, handle denied/unsupported.
Interface blocked without optional sensor; assumed microphone permission.
Denied permission, no device, disconnect, fallback behavior.
worked: Contoh drag: pointerdown records pointerId/start pose, sets capture; moves update target from local-space displacement; pointerup estimates velocity and releases; pointercancel stops gesture with explicit state cleanup. Native touch scrolling requires touch-action policy appropriate target, not blanket disable page scrolling. Multi-touch introduction must either hand off to pinch or preserve a single-pointer rule.
workflow: Define intents; inspect source capabilities; normalize coordinates/time; implement recognizer lifecycle; map events to intent; handle cancellation/permission; test devices and keyboard.
mastery: Dapat membangun cancellable drag recognizer, velocity estimation dan coordinate conversion dengan fixtures.
advanced: Coalesced/predicted events; gesture arbitration; touch ergonomics; gaze input; voice commands; sensor fusion; body tracking; multimodal input.

title: Interaction Design and Direct Manipulation
purpose: Menentukan mapping yang terasa jelas dan konsisten antara tindakan pengguna, state, dan visual motion.
boundary: Input engineering D21 menyediakan events; D22 menetapkan feedback, mapping, affordances dan task behavior. Kenyamanan/perception membutuhkan D32/D34.
topics: Feedback dan affordances
Press/focus/selection motion menyampaikan status tindakan. Feedback harus cukup cepat dan distinguishable tanpa menghambat task.
Map idle/hover/pressed/focused/disabled states with semantic equivalents.
Click acknowledgement hanya lewat subtle motion; keyboard focus missing.
Task success, latency observations, keyboard and reduced-motion review.
Direct manipulation
Object follows intent with predictable coordinate mapping. Visual compliance, constraints dan ownership membuat drag feel berbeda.
target=initialPose+mappedDisplacement; constrain before/after spring according to desired semantics.
Lag feels disconnected; spring crosses hard boundary.
Input/output trajectory, constraint adherence and release transitions.
Inertia snapping dan settling
Release motion dapat mengikuti physical or authored model. Snap target selection is interaction policy, not merely damping.
Choose target based position/velocity/context; settle from current x,v.
High-velocity release snaps opposite intent; repeated snapping oscillates.
Boundary velocities, nearest target ties and interruption.
Scroll-driven dan view-driven behavior
Scroll progress can drive presentation continuously; trigger events drive timed animations. These are different semantics.
Compute progress from defined scroll range or use supported timeline; fallback retains content.
Triggered animation lags scroll expectation; division by zero short page.
Forward/back scroll, resize, inactive range and capability fallback.
Navigation dan shared elements
Motion links before/after views while semantic navigation occurs. Layout measurements, image loading and focus changes affect mapping.
Capture before/after bounds; transition ownership; complete state/focus regardless animation.
Duplicate element, stale geometry, navigation blocked on failed animation.
Back/forward, rapid navigation, dynamic content and reduced-motion.
Cursor following dan magnetic mapping
Cursor-following is spatial response; magnetic targets alter perceived mapping. Strength, bounds and input capability determine usability.
Displacement function with bounded influence radius, decay and keyboard-independent action.
Essential target evades pointer; touch device stuck in hover.
Boundary positions, precision tasks, touch/no-hover and focus.
UX measurement dan adaptation
Motion quality depends task/audience. Preferences and context may require different trajectories or no spatial animation.
Define hypothesis and success metrics; compare observed task outcomes.
Generic premium style claimed universally better.
Usability sessions, task errors/time, qualitative review and accessibility.
worked: Contoh carousel: dragging follows finger directly; release chooses nearest reachable card using position and velocity; settling uses continuous x,v. Arrow key sets same target without needing drag velocity. Reduced-motion switches to immediate/short nonspatial update while keeping selection and focus clear. Test resize mid-drag and interrupt while settling.
workflow: Define task/intent; choose feedback mapping; establish constraints; implement direct/control paths; define release/navigation behavior; test full input set; observe users before claiming preference.
mastery: Dapat menerangkan motion function per interaction dan menjaga usability di bawah interruption, resize dan reduced motion.
advanced: FLIP layout transitions; transition choreography; input-to-photon latency; spatial navigation; touch mechanics; interaction accessibility; adaptive feedback.

title: Synchronization and Distributed Motion Systems
purpose: Menyelaraskan motion antarstream, perangkat atau users sambil menangani offset, drift, latency, missingness dan authority.
boundary: Synchronization tidak hanya start bersamaan. Clock mapping D03, networking semantics, and audio/media rates harus dibedakan dari perceived synchrony D32.
topics: Clock offset dan drift
Shared timestamp units tidak menjamin shared origin/rate. Offset dan drift perlu estimator dan uncertainty.
t_remote≈a t_local+b; calibrate using timestamp exchanges with network-delay assumptions.
RTT/2 claimed exact one-way delay; re-sync causes jump.
Simulated asymmetric delay, drift and discontinuities.
Buffers dan jitter management
Buffer trades latency for stable presentation. Policy for late/missing data decides behavior.
Timestamp-ordered queue with target presentation delay, interpolation window and bounded capacity.
Queue grows forever; samples drawn by arrival order.
Bursty arrivals, missing packets, out-of-order data and bounded memory.
Prediction dan reconciliation
Client prediction reduces perceived input delay; authoritative correction may move state. Correction needs continuity and error bounds.
Replay pending inputs from authoritative snapshot; smooth presentation separately if appropriate.
Physics state smoothed inconsistent with server; double input application.
Delay/loss fixture, correction residual and replay determinism.
Deterministic lockstep dan rollback
Lockstep relies consistent simulation/input order. Rollback stores states and replays late inputs. Float and platform differences can break exact sync.
Hash snapshots; fixed seeds; deterministic event order; checkpoint ring buffer.
Seed shared but RNG call order differs; incompatible engine versions.
Cross-run state hashes, late-input replay and platform comparison.
Audio visual haptic synchronization
Different streams use own clocks and output latencies. Master clock and correction policy need explicit choice.
Schedule against chosen master; estimate drift; adjust rate/buffer where supported.
Render timestamp treated actual presentation time.
Known markers, instrumented timestamps and device-level observations.
Authority consistency dan conflicts
Multiple users editing parameters need ownership/version semantics. Last arrival is not necessarily latest intent.
Sequence numbers, versioned commands, explicit arbitration, snapshot plus deltas.
Stale packet overrides new goal; feedback loop among peers.
Reordering, reconnect, duplicate command and authority handoff.
Fault handling dan observability
Disconnect/reconnect and degraded clocks affect continuity. Log time mappings and state age without overclaiming measurement accuracy.
Bound extrapolation duration; fallback freeze/degrade; rebuild snapshots on reconnect.
Infinite extrapolation, teleport on recovered state.
Long disconnect, stale snapshot, clock reset and measurable recovery.
worked: Contoh remote object sends 20Hz snapshots while display runs 60Hz. Maintain timestamp buffer and render slightly behind remote latest time to interpolate two states. When future sample absent, bounded extrapolation may be allowed, then freeze/degrade. Choosing 100ms buffer improves availability at expense latency; value is a design example, not universal optimal threshold. Plot state age and correction magnitude during network impairment.
workflow: Choose authority/master clock; define timestamp contract; estimate mapping; design buffer/prediction; bound stale behavior; instrument age/drift; test impairment and reconnect.
mastery: Dapat membedakan transport latency, clock error, render delay dan perceptual synchrony; reproduce network fixtures.
advanced: PTP/NTP clock discipline; distributed simulation; collaborative XR; networked physics; media synchronization; rollback netcode; causal consistency; consensus boundaries.

title: 2D Graphics and Rendering
purpose: Mengubah state motion menjadi gambar 2D melalui vector/raster paths, text, layers dan compositing.
boundary: Rendering path bukan induk motion generation. DOM/SVG/Canvas dipilih berdasarkan content, accessibility, workload dan editing needs; GPU detail D26.
topics: Raster vector dan scene organization
Vector describes geometry; raster stores sampled pixels. Either can be animated. Scene objects need z-order, transform, visibility and ownership.
Evaluate scene snapshot then render; define coordinate and pixel conventions.
Rendering mutates simulation; object order changes unexpectedly.
Known layered scene, deterministic snapshot and visibility tests.
DOM CSS dan layout
DOM supports semantic content; animated layout can trigger work beyond one element. Transform/opacity often reduce work but actual compositing must be profiled.
Prefer clear property ownership; separate geometry reads/writes; keep focus semantics.
Layout thrashing; will-change on everything; offscreen content focusable.
Performance trace, semantic keyboard flow and dynamic layout.
SVG paths dan vector motion
Paths, strokes, fills, transforms and clipping offer retained vector control. Path length units and morph correspondence require explicit handling.
Stroke reveal through length/dash properties; evaluate viewBox and local transforms.
Paths resampled mismatched; percentage origin misunderstood.
Endpoint reveal, viewBox scaling, path morph topology.
Canvas rendering
Immediate-mode renderer redraws content; state and hit-testing remain application responsibilities. CSS size differs backing buffer size.
Set backing dimensions by target pixel scale, transform coordinates consistently, clear/compose every frame.
Blurry output, double scaling, missing keyboard equivalents.
Known pixel geometry across DPRs, resize and hit-test mapping.
Typography dan shaping
Text motion must preserve shaping, language direction, line breaking and readability. Grapheme clusters differ from Unicode code points.
Shape/layout before glyph motion or use browser text semantics; animate groups with language-aware boundaries.
Splitting combining marks/Arabic shaping; line shift during font loading.
Multiple scripts, fallback fonts, copy/accessibility text and loading states.
Masks clipping filters dan layers
Effects add intermediate surfaces and bounds. Blur shadow and masks can expand rendering footprint and change compositing.
Track effect bounds and alpha convention; cache only stable layers.
Clipped blur, excessive large offscreen buffers.
Boundary pixels, transparent edges, animated effect extents.
Sprites raster assets dan batching
Sprites require atlas metadata, sampling rules, frame duration and asset lifecycle. Image sequence timing is not necessarily one frame per display tick.
Index by animation local time; include padding for filtered atlas sampling.
Atlas bleeding, skipped durations, decode stalls.
Frame timing, texture boundaries, loading failure and memory budget.
worked: Contoh high-DPI Canvas: CSS viewport 400×300, device scale 2 yields backing 800×600. Apply context scaling once and keep logical geometry/hit testing in CSS pixels. Reset transform appropriately after resize because canvas state resets. Labels essential to task still require semantic DOM representation. Increasing pixel scale improves detail but quadruples pixel workload at scale 2.
workflow: Choose rendering path; define scene/value ownership; normalize sizing; render static fixtures; connect evaluator; add effects/text/assets; profile and check semantic alternatives.
mastery: Dapat memilih DOM/SVG/Canvas dengan alasan, mengelola high-DPI dan typography, serta menguji animated bounds.
advanced: Font shaping; vector tessellation; rasterization; signed distance field text; 2D scene graphs; dirty rectangles; sprite packing; retained/immediate hybrid renderers.

title: 3D Graphics and Scene Rendering
purpose: Membentuk gambar dari scene spatial dengan cameras, visibility, materials, lights dan rendering algorithms.
boundary: 3D rendering tidak otomatis physical simulation. Animation D19 menghasilkan poses; renderer mengevaluasi image formation dengan approximations yang dipilih.
topics: Scene graphs dan transforms
Hierarchical transforms and visibility organize objects. Camera and light objects also have frame conventions. Shared resources differ from shared transform parents.
Update world transforms in dependency order; distinguish object instance and mesh asset.
Stale parent transform; cloned object shares mutable material unintentionally.
Parent-child fixtures and independent instances.
Cameras projection dan depth
Perspective maps depth nonlinearly; near/far planes affect clipping and precision. FOV/aspect changes geometry perception.
Define camera frame, projection convention, near/far and depth range.
Z-fighting, clipping, aspect stale after resize.
Known geometry projection, resize, near-plane crossing.
Meshes normals dan materials
Geometry, normals, UVs and material model jointly determine appearance. Tangent spaces and nonuniform transforms need correct handling.
Validate attribute counts; normalize transformed normals; define PBR assumptions explicitly.
Flipped winding, tangent mismatch, textures in wrong color space.
Normal visualization and controlled lighting/material tests.
Lighting shadows dan transport
Direct lighting, shadows and indirect transport use different algorithms/approximations. Light units and exposure define consistent brightness.
State light type/intensity, shadow map settings, environment and tone mapping.
Shadow acne, detached shadows, brightness changes after pipeline mix.
Fixed scene with intensity/exposure sweeps and shadow geometry.
Rasterization ray tracing dan path tracing
Rasterization projects primitives; ray methods sample scene intersections/transport. Quality/cost depend samples, paths, denoising and material complexity.
Choose algorithm by target; inspect variance and bias separately.
Denoised still looks good but flickers over animation.
Samples-per-pixel convergence plus temporal sequence review.
Volumes particles dan LOD
Volumes integrate density over paths; particles approximate effects; LOD changes geometry/shading complexity. Transitions can affect motion continuity.
Define transparency sorting/blending and LOD selection/hysteresis.
Popping, transparent ordering artifacts, particle overdraw.
Camera sweeps, LOD transitions, dense effects and depth boundaries.
Resources and scene lifecycle
Meshes, materials, textures and render targets own memory. Scene removal must dispose resources according to engine sharing rules.
Track allocation/ownership; reuse resources; recover device/context loss where supported.
GPU memory leaks; disposing shared texture still in use.
Repeated scene swaps, target resize, loading errors and loss recovery.
worked: Contoh orbiting camera keeps target fixed while perspective/aspect updated on resize. Compare object-space motion and camera motion independently: identical image displacement does not imply identical world movement. Test near-plane crossing and transparent surfaces while orbiting. For physical plausibility keep lighting/exposure fixed during motion unless the intended camera system changes them.
workflow: Define scene/frame conventions; verify camera/static appearance; connect animation; choose lighting/render algorithm; manage resources; profile image/runtime quality across sequence.
mastery: Dapat menguji projection/normals/resources, memilih rendering method dan membedakan temporal flicker dari pose error.
advanced: Global illumination; spectral rendering; participating media; bidirectional transport; real-time ray tracing; virtual geometry; impostors; physically based camera models.

title: GPU Programming and Parallel Graphics Computation
purpose: Mengeksekusi rendering/simulation pada GPU dengan contracts untuk memory, pipelines, parallelism dan precision.
boundary: Shader language adalah implementation layer. GPU speed tidak menggantikan model correctness; actual support/limits harus diuji pada target.
topics: Pipeline stages
Vertex, fragment dan compute stages mempunyai inputs/outputs dan execution semantics berbeda. Work submission asynchronous terhadap CPU.
Declare resource bindings, layouts and render/compute passes; respect stage capabilities.
CPU timestamp treated GPU completion; shader interface mismatch.
Minimal known pipeline, validation messages and measured completion where available.
Buffers textures dan layouts
Alignment, stride, type formats and usage flags determine data interpretation. CPU struct layout must match GPU ABI.
Use explicit byte offsets/strides and format conversions; bounds based resource dimensions.
Silent corrupt uniforms; index out-of-range.
Known patterns through buffers/textures, boundary indices and layout assertions.
Parallel work dan races
Work items execute concurrently; ordering absent unless guaranteed synchronization. Atomics provide specific operations, not general sequence determinism.
Separate phases/passes; use barriers only at supported scope; avoid read/write conflict.
Barrier assumed cross-workgroup; floating reduction nondeterministic.
Small oracle compare, repeated runs and adversarial scheduling inputs.
Shader math dan precision
Float precision, derivatives and interpolation affect rendered motion. Branch divergence and numeric singularities need handling.
Guard divisions/normalization; choose precision by scale; handle discontinuous derivatives.
NaN propagates texture coordinates; artifacts at large world positions.
Extreme coordinates, near-zero input, shader debug visualizations.
Compute-driven motion
GPU can update particles/fields then feed render pipeline. Dataflow and previous/current state ownership determine correctness.
Ping-pong buffers/textures; dispatch counts rounded with bounds guard.
Last group writes beyond particle count; update in place conflicts neighbors.
Counts not multiple group size, deterministic fixtures and CPU reference.
Optimization and measurement
Batching/instancing reduce submissions; memory bandwidth, occupancy and overdraw can dominate. GPU timings are device-dependent.
Measure representative passes; reduce transfers; profile bottleneck before changing algorithms.
Optimizing arithmetic while transfer bound; synchronous readback stalls.
Target-device traces, batch size sweeps, dense/sparse scenes.
Portability validation dan recovery
API versions/extensions/limits differ; context/device loss needs fallback. Shader translation does not guarantee behavior equivalent.
Feature detection, validation layer where supported, graceful fallback, resource rebuild.
Unsupported format assumed universal; lost device loop retries indefinitely.
Capability-limited path, resource rebuild, unsupported features.
worked: Contoh GPU particles: compute pass reads positions/velocities A and writes B; render reads B; next simulation swaps roles. Every invocation checks index<N. Neighbor interactions must read consistent A, not partly updated B. Benchmark simulation, rendering and uploads separately. A tiny system can be slower GPU-bound due overhead, so keep CPU reference for correctness and small workloads.
workflow: Establish capabilities/layouts; implement minimal pipeline; verify oracle; define pass synchronization; add realistic workload; profile; support cleanup/loss/fallback.
mastery: Dapat membaca GPU data layout, mencegah race/out-of-bounds, dan memisahkan CPU submission dari GPU completion.
advanced: WGSL/GLSL/HLSL; CUDA-like compute; subgroup operations; indirect draws; bindless resources; GPU BVHs; tiled rendering; GPU fluid simulation.

title: Temporal Rendering and Image Formation
purpose: Menyampling perubahan scene selama exposure dan antarframes untuk menghasilkan image sequence yang sesuai motion serta display target.
boundary: Ini image formation, bukan trajectory smoothing. Menambahkan motion blur tidak memperbaiki physics salah; TAA tidak membuktikan temporal continuity.
topics: Exposure dan shutter interval
Frame image dapat mengintegrasi scene selama interval exposure. Sample timestamp dan exposure window adalah konsep berbeda.
Define shutter open/close relative frame; integrate radiance over time with chosen weighting.
One pose blurred screen-space claimed physically exact.
Known moving edge and expected exposure displacement.
Motion blur dan temporal samples
Motion blur dapat berasal multiple time samples atau approximation velocity buffers. Deformation, camera motion dan occlusion complicate reconstruction.
Evaluate transforms/geometry at subframe samples; or specify motion-vector approximation limits.
Camera motion omitted; velocity vectors wrong units.
Translation/rotation/deformation fixtures and occlusion crossings.
Temporal aliasing
Frame sampling dapat membuat wheels apparently reverse or thin features flicker. Exposure blur and sampling change observations, not underlying motion.
Compare frequency relative frame cadence; increase samples or bandwidth limit when appropriate.
Higher image resolution assumed cures temporal aliasing.
Periodic known motions at multiple rates and exposure settings.
Temporal accumulation dan antialiasing
TAA combines history with current sample. Reprojection, disocclusion detection and weighting determine ghosting/stability.
Maintain motion vectors/history; reject invalid history after scene/camera changes.
Trails, history leaking across object IDs, reset omitted.
Camera cuts, moving edges, transparent objects and abrupt lighting.
Reprojection dan frame interpolation
Reprojection predicts viewpoint changes; frame interpolation synthesizes samples. Neither is equivalent actual evaluated scene at target time in all cases.
Use depth/motion and validity masks; expose unsupported disocclusions.
Hallucinated surfaces treated actual geometry; latency not counted.
Newly revealed regions, occlusions, thin structures and timestamp correctness.
Rolling shutter dan acquisition
Image rows may correspond different times. Captured reference distortions can originate acquisition, not object deformation.
Row-dependent time model matched camera assumptions.
Inferring rigid shape from one distorted fast-motion frame.
Controlled scan/rotation fixture and global-shutter comparison.
Quality cost dan reproducibility
Sample count, random pattern, denoising and exposure affect time-dependent quality. Seeds and renders need recorded settings.
Compare variance/bias and temporal consistency at known quality targets.
Nice single frame used to approve sequence; denoiser flicker unnoticed.
Sequence playback, representative cuts, convergence and decoded PTS.
worked: Contoh object speed 240px/s pada 60fps moves 4px antarframes. Exposure 1/120s gives ideal translation smear 2px; exposure 1/60s gives 4px. Ini conditional ideal calculation, bukan universal camera measurement. Rendering one pose then applying arbitrary blur radius may not match shape/occlusion evolution. Document approximation and compare subframe integration fixture.
workflow: Define cadence/exposure; choose temporal rendering method; implement known moving geometry; verify vectors/samples; review disocclusion and cuts; measure runtime/quality; validate encoded sequence.
mastery: Dapat menghitung exposure displacement, menjelaskan ghosting dan temporal aliasing, serta membedakan interpolation synthetic dari scene evaluation.
advanced: Spatiotemporal reconstruction; motion-compensated filtering; temporal superresolution; adaptive time sampling; rolling-shutter inversion; motion-vector generation; temporal denoising.

title: Compositing Image Processing and Visual Effects
purpose: Menggabungkan serta memproses image layers dengan contracts untuk color, alpha, coordinates dan temporal behavior.
boundary: Compositing tidak boleh menyembunyikan wrong data assumptions. Color management D40 menentukan delivery; temporal processing D27 menentukan history effects.
topics: Alpha dan layer composition
Straight dan premultiplied alpha menyimpan colors berbeda. Composite order noncommutative; transparent RGB can affect filtering.
Premultiplied over: C=Ca+Cb(1−αa), α=αa+αb(1−αa); colors already multiplied.
Dark/light halos from mixing conventions.
Transparent-edge fixtures and analytically known layer results.
Color spaces dan transfer functions
Encoded RGB tidak umumnya proportional light. Operations linear-light versus display-encoded memberi results berbeda. Color primaries juga harus diketahui.
Decode transfer, convert primaries if required, process, encode output; metadata retained.
sRGB arithmetic labeled physically correct; double gamma conversion.
Gray ramps, reference patches and controlled blending comparisons.
Masks clipping dan matte quality
Matte represents coverage/selection; antialias and feather affect edge. Moving matte needs alignment over time.
Keep matte coordinate/time grid aligned with image; define invert/threshold/feather.
Edges swim, matte offset, clipping blur beyond bounds.
Edge movement, thin features, subpixel motion and layer alignment.
Keying rotoscoping dan tracking
Keying estimates foreground separation; rotoscoping authoring and tracking can assist but errors accumulate.
Separate track/matte provenance; inspect occlusion and spill suppression.
Tracking confidence assumed correct matte; temporal jitter.
Difficult edges, motion blur, occlusions and representative playback.
Filtering warping dan displacement
Spatial filters and geometric warps change frequency/bounds. Resampling method and edge behavior affect quality.
Define kernel, sampling coordinates, wrap/clamp and inverse mapping.
Forward warp holes, repeated resampling blur, aliasing.
Checkerboards, moving grids and boundary behavior.
Postprocessing glow blur grading
Effects have radiometric and editorial semantics. Glow/blur consumes bandwidth and can alter contrast/readability.
Process bright contribution with chosen space/threshold; preserve unclipped intermediate range where needed.
Clipped highlights, excessive luminance flicker, oversized buffers.
Dynamic brightness cases, bounds, text legibility and cost.
Temporal compositing dan pipeline order
Temporal filters, exposure, grading and composite order can affect flicker and alpha correctness. Ordering should be documented and versioned.
Compare stage outputs; keep timestamps and alpha/color contracts each interface.
Different preview/export pipeline; footage misaligned by one frame.
Stage-by-stage regression, known markers and final decode.
worked: Contoh red foreground with alpha 0.5 over blue background. In premultiplied representation foreground color is (0.5,0,0), not (1,0,0). Applying premultiplied formula to straight RGB produces too-bright edge. Choose working color space before interpreting numerical result. A static correct edge is insufficient: scale/rotate the layer to exercise filtering during motion.
workflow: Inventory image/color/alpha contracts; normalize; compose static oracle; add warps/effects; inspect intermediate stages; playback moving edges; compare preview/export pipeline.
mastery: Dapat mendiagnosis alpha halos, color-space errors, bounds clipping dan temporal matte instability.
advanced: Deep compositing; optical-flow retiming; HDR compositing; chromatic effects; procedural VFX; volumetric compositing; color transforms; film pipelines.

title: Audio Haptics and Multisensory Output
purpose: Menghubungkan sound, visual motion dan tactile output melalui measured signals, time contracts dan designed response.
boundary: Audio-reactive features tidak otomatis memahami musik; haptic waveform tidak sama across actuators; perceptual effects D32 memerlukan context/human evidence.
topics: Audio synthesis dan processing
Oscillators, envelopes, filters dan mixing membuat audio output. Sample rate and amplitude representation menentukan evaluation.
Generate/control audio using audio clock; envelope attacks/releases avoid clicks.
Visual rAF drives sample-level synthesis; clipping.
Known-frequency waveform, level bounds and discontinuity checks.
Waveform spectrum dan features
RMS, amplitude peak, spectrum and spectral flux represent different properties. True peak/LUFS need specific algorithms, not RMS relabeling.
Define window/hop/channel aggregation and calibration.
Mono cancellation, DC counted energy, mislabeled level metrics.
Known tones, silence, impulses, stereo phase cases.
Onsets rhythm dan mapping
Onsets, beats and tempo are distinct estimates. Mapping visual scale to loudness needs smoothing and bounded response.
Feature→normalized control→motion evaluator; threshold with hysteresis/refractory as appropriate.
Every peak triggers beat; excessive visual flicker.
Silence/noise/tempo changes, false triggers and review.
Spatial audio
Position/orientation and acoustics shape perceived audio location. Listener frame must align visual scene.
Update sources/listener at controlled rate; choose attenuation/spatialization model.
Left/right inversion, source position in wrong unit.
Known source trajectories and listener rotations.
Haptic waveforms dan actuator limits
Device actuator supports certain frequencies/intensities/time granularity. Software event cannot guarantee identical tactile sensation.
Map intent to supported envelope/pattern with capability fallback.
Unsupported haptics essential for task; intensity too rapidly repeated.
Capability detection, timing logs and device/user observations.
Scheduling synchronization dan latency
Audio scheduler and presentation clock may differ. Processing timestamp does not measure acoustic or tactile output time.
Schedule against audio clock, log mapping, estimate output delays where measurable.
Audio event callback assumed exact speaker onset.
Known synchronized markers, instrumented device observations.
Multisensory semantics dan adaptation
Output channels should reinforce task meaning. Redundant alternatives support silent devices and users who cannot use a channel.
State information in accessible visual/text plus optional sound/haptic cues.
Notification meaningful only through sound; sensory overload.
Silent/no-haptic paths, preference controls and context evaluation.
worked: Contoh audio-reactive particle radius from window RMS. Remove/inspect DC as appropriate; normalize with declared range and smooth time-aware envelope. radius=base+gain·feature is a mapping choice, not physical relationship. Keep radius bounds so silence remains readable and peaks do not obscure labels. If beat synchronization is needed, RMS alone is insufficient.
workflow: Define channel purpose; inspect capability; specify signal metrics; align clocks; build bounded mappings; avoid clicks/overload; test silent/fallback modes and actual device output.
mastery: Dapat menghasilkan valid audio features, menjelaskan latency boundaries dan membuat mappings yang tetap berguna tanpa sound/haptics.
advanced: DSP synthesis; spatial acoustics; auditory displays; music information retrieval; tactile rendering; force feedback; vibrotactile design; multimodal timing research.

title: Spatial Computing and Immersive Motion
purpose: Menyatukan tracking, spatial anchors, rendering dan input dalam AR/VR/MR experiences dengan coordinate/time contracts yang konsisten.
boundary: XR menambah spatial/display semantics; ia tidak menghapus domains dasar. Comfort perlu target-device dan human evaluation, bukan hanya high fps.
topics: Reference spaces dan anchors
Spatial reference dapat local/floor/world-aligned sesuai platform. Anchors may drift/relocalize; tracked space bukan fixed immutable geometry.
Tag every pose/reference space and timestamp; handle reference reset.
World content jumps after tracking recovery.
Reference-space changes, origin resets, anchor loss.
Head hand body gaze tracking
Tracking provides estimates and confidence/validity. Different modalities require permissions and fallback.
Use pose at requested/predicted frame time with validity checks.
Stale hand pose remains interactive; invalid data silently zero.
Occlusion, tracking loss, capability and reconnect.
Stereo dan immersive rendering
Per-eye transforms/projection produce spatial perception. Improper scale/interpupillary assumptions distort experience.
Use platform-provided eye views/projections; correct units and depth.
Mono image duplicated, world scale mismatch.
Known-scale scene, per-eye geometry and resizing/runtime checks.
Prediction reprojection dan latency
Head prediction/reprojection reduce perceived lag but introduce approximation. Full motion-to-photon includes tracking, rendering and display.
Match predicted presentation pose; keep timestamps and validity.
CPU frame duration claimed total latency.
Measured device path where possible, fast head motion, disocclusion.
Locomotion dan interaction spaces
Teleport, continuous locomotion, grabbing and physical movement have different constraints. User boundary and reach matter.
Align input intent, spatial affordance and movement mode; preserve orientation context.
Virtual movement conflicts real movement or reachable space.
Boundary/reach scenarios, mode switches, reduced-motion options.
Presence embodiment dan comfort
Presence and comfort are human outcomes. Visual self-motion, acceleration, field of view, conflict and user differences affect response.
Declare hypotheses/preferences; provide adjustable controls; review representative motion.
Comfort certification from technical profiler alone.
Human evaluation plus technical checks, kept separate.
Session lifecycle dan degradation
XR sessions can pause/end, lose tracking or change available inputs. Normal app content should recover coherently.
Explicit enter/pause/resume/end state; dispose/rebuild resources and restore focus.
Orphan loops after session end; content inaccessible outside XR.
Repeated sessions, loss recovery and non-XR fallback.
worked: Contoh AR object anchored table. Store anchor-relative transform rather than camera-relative offset. On tracking invalid, disable precise placement and preserve last meaningful state with clear status. Reacquisition can alter anchor estimate; apply documented presentation policy while preserving spatial truth. A smoothly hidden jump can still misplace content; measure alignment separately.
workflow: Inspect target runtime; define spaces/units; implement static anchored scene; add tracked input; profile stereo/latency; handle loss/session lifecycle; conduct comfort/task review.
mastery: Dapat mengaudit reference spaces, valid poses, lifecycle dan latency evidence boundaries.
advanced: OpenXR/WebXR; SLAM anchors; spatial mapping; hand physics; passthrough composition; foveated rendering; shared XR; embodiment research.

title: Robotics Mechatronics and Physical Actuation
purpose: Menghubungkan motion models, planning dan control dengan actuators, sensors serta physical operating limits.
boundary: Pembahasan repo adalah knowledge dan simulasi. Physical deployment membutuhkan equipment-specific calibration, constraints dan verification; UI animation parameters bukan actuator settings.
topics: Actuators dan transmissions
Motors, servos, linear actuators dan pneumatic mechanisms mempunyai torque/speed/thermal limits berbeda. Gearing changes inertia/friction/backlash.
Model input→actuator response→mechanical output with units and limits.
Ideal torque model ignores saturation/deadband.
Datasheet/model comparison and bounded simulation fixtures.
Encoders sensors dan calibration
Position/velocity/force observations mempunyai quantization, bias dan mounting conventions. Homing sets reference, not universal absolute truth.
Establish zero/reference, scale/sign, timestamp and valid range.
Encoder counts interpreted radians without conversion.
Known positions/directions, stationary noise and disconnect behavior.
Embedded real-time execution
Control cycles need bounded execution and jitter. General-purpose UI scheduling cannot ensure hard deadlines.
Separate sensing/control/actuation phases; measure worst-case timing and overruns.
Average timing presented deadline guarantee.
Timing traces, load spikes and deadline handling.
Manipulators mobile robots dan drones
Kinematics/dynamics differ by platform; nonholonomic mobility, flight dynamics and manipulation need appropriate models.
Use platform state/action constraints; connect planner/controller with consistent frames.
Holonomic plan given nonholonomic plant.
Reachability/dynamics feasibility and task-specific simulated cases.
Communication buses dan interfaces
Commands/data over serial/CAN/network need sequence, rate, integrity and stale-command policy.
Timestamp commands, enforce bounded validity, acknowledge according protocol.
Old packets continue actuation after disconnect.
Reordering, duplicates, delays and connection loss simulation.
Limits fault handling dan safety functions
Physical bounds, watchdogs and protective functions must not depend solely on presentation animation. Failure response is system-specific engineering.
Independent limits, state validity checks, stop/fallback contract appropriate equipment.
Simulation PASS claimed hardware safety; software indicator mistaken enforcement.
Fault injection, command saturation, sensor failure and independently verified mechanisms.
Kinetic installations dan animatronics
Artistic movement still has mechanism, audience distance, synchronization and maintenance constraints.
Separate choreography from low-level limits; schedule feasible trajectories.
Beautiful path requires impossible actuator acceleration.
Trajectory feasibility, endurance model, synchronized simulation and inspection plan.
worked: Contoh simulated pan-tilt mechanism accepts angles in radians and max velocity. Choreography supplies desired poses; trajectory generator applies limits; controller tracks; simulated actuator saturates. Commands carry sequence/time validity. Test dropped sensor input and delayed command using simulation. Do not infer actual mechanism torque, thermal behavior or stop performance from this example.
workflow: Define physical platform/model; establish units/calibration; implement simulation; constrain trajectory; validate controller/interfaces; document hardware-specific checks separately before deployment.
mastery: Dapat menerjemahkan motion intent ke feasible trajectory dan menjelaskan limits serta fault contracts tanpa menyamakan simulasi dengan hardware proof.
advanced: Robot middleware; real-time OS; motor control; force control; compliant actuation; drone flight control; industrial motion; animatronics; kinetic architecture.

title: Motion Perception and Human Factors
purpose: Menjelaskan hubungan antara stimulus bergerak, perception, attention, task dan individual/context differences.
boundary: Perceptual outcome tidak dapat disimpulkan hanya dari equations atau screenshot. Pisahkan stimulus properties, scientific findings scoped, heuristic design dan actual human observations.
topics: Apparent motion dan sampling perception
Discrete images dapat menghasilkan perceived continuous motion atau ambiguity. Frame rate, stimulus structure dan exposure sama-sama relevan.
Define spatial displacement, cadence, contrast and exposure of stimulus before interpretation.
Universal smoothness threshold based fps alone.
Controlled stimuli/settings and participant observations; technical cadence separately.
Speed acceleration dan weight impressions
Perceived speed/weight dipengaruhi trajectory, timing, shape dan context. Physical mass cannot generally recovered dari visual acceleration tanpa force information.
Track stimulus trajectory and explicitly label inferred impression as subjective/conditional.
Slow object called objectively heavy; numeric velocity equated perceived speed.
Controlled parameter comparisons and actual judgments with stated participants.
Biological motion dan expression
Coordinated joint patterns can convey action/identity/style. Recognition depends stimulus and observer familiarity.
Compare intact/scrambled point-light patterns when researching biological-motion effects.
Any joint movement claimed human-like; acting judged from one frame.
Full sequences, recognizability tasks and demographic/context limits.
Attention salience dan tracking
Movement can capture attention but competing cues/goals affect outcome. Design plan is not measured gaze.
Define target regions/time windows; choose behavioral or eye-tracking measurements appropriate task.
Motion always assumed dominant; invented saliency percentages.
Task success, gaze if measured, competing cue scenarios.
Temporal rhythm continuity dan causality
Relative timing and sequencing influence grouping and apparent causal relationships. A universal delay threshold is inappropriate across tasks.
Specify onset/offset relation, object geometry and stimulus parameters.
Fixed milliseconds rule without context; coincidence considered causal proof.
Controlled timing sweep and stated perception task.
Cognitive load dan predictability
Motion can explain transition or distract from reading/decision. Novelty, density and repeated movement affect demand.
Form hypothesis tied task; compare comprehension/errors with alternatives.
More movement claimed more engagement without evidence.
Task measures, qualitative observations and repeated-use sessions.
Crossmodal perception dan variation
Sound/visual/haptic timing can alter interpretation; sensitivity differs by individuals/devices/context.
Measure channel timing and subjective judgments separately, with actual setup.
Synchrony tolerance assumed universal; device timestamp equated perceived onset.
Participant/device-specific tests and uncertainty reporting.
worked: Contoh dua cards: satu bergerak cepat lalu berhenti tajam, satu bergerak dengan long deceleration. Reviewer mungkin menilai card kedua lebih berat, tetapi trajectory sendiri tidak mengidentifikasi physical mass. Jika ingin evidence, gunakan controlled comparison dan tanyakan specified perceptual task. Catat desain sebagai heuristic sampai hasil pengguna tersedia.
workflow: Define stimulus/task; identify applicable research; preserve population/system limits; separate measurement and inference; evaluate alternatives; record observations and uncertainty.
mastery: Dapat membedakan mathematical motion, physical explanation dan perceived impression; merancang evaluasi tanpa invented human outcomes.
advanced: Psychophysics; ecological perception; eye movements; predictive processing; visual attention; biological motion; temporal cognition; crossmodal integration.

title: Animation Principles Choreography and Narrative
purpose: Menyusun motion yang menyampaikan maksud, hierarchy, rhythm dan emotion melalui hubungan action, camera, typography dan editing.
boundary: Prinsip animasi adalah desain dan craft; efektivitas spesifik membutuhkan audience/context evaluation. Jangan menjadikan setiap prinsip sebagai efek wajib.
topics: Timing spacing dan rhythm
Timing menentukan kapan events terjadi; spacing menentukan displacement antarposes. Rhythm dapat dibangun melalui repeats, contrasts dan pauses.
Mark beats and holds; evaluate trajectory spacing against intended emphasis.
Constant busy movement; changing duration without adjusting readability.
Playback with task/message review and readable hold durations.
Anticipation follow-through overlapping action
Preparatory cues and delayed secondary movement can clarify action. Their size/duration depends scale and intent.
Separate primary action, preparation, settle and secondary response.
Decorative anticipation delays direct UI feedback.
Compare action clarity and response timing across contexts.
Arcs squash stretch dan exaggeration
Stylization communicates qualities while preserving identity/constraints when required. Volume or shape invariants are design choices.
Define allowed deformation and path shape; choose exaggeration bounded by message.
Text distortion unreadable; critical task geometry misleading.
Endpoint identity, legibility, constraints and audience review.
Staging hierarchy dan attention handoff
Motion should make intended focal point available without unnecessary competition. Spatial grouping and timing coordinate information flow.
Assign one primary emphasis per beat unless deliberate complexity; label this authored heuristic.
Many simultaneous highlights; attention claim without measurement.
Message comprehension and visual review of full sequence.
Transitions continuity dan editing
Cuts, wipes, morphs and shared elements create relationships between scenes. Continuity can be spatial, temporal, semantic or stylistic.
Select transition according relationship; preserve orientation and content context.
Transition obscures task, contradictory direction or jump.
Before/after understanding, fast navigation and contextual review.
Camera motion dan visual narrative
Camera angle/path/scale communicates viewpoint. Object and camera motion interactions affect composition and comfort.
Plan shot framing, target, path, focus and transitions; inspect projected composition.
Unnecessary orbit, subject cropped during move.
Full shot path, safe areas, subject visibility and viewing context.
Style systems dan iteration
Reusable motion tokens create coherence but need context-specific overrides. Style should be concrete parameters and rules, not adjectives alone.
Define timing ranges, easing families, response rules, hierarchy and exceptions.
Every element uses same easing regardless function.
Compare families of states/shots and note purposeful deviations.
worked: Contoh motion explainer: establish headline, move supporting diagram, hold for reading, highlight relationship, then transition. Timeline allocates motion and stillness according information load. Do not animate all words continuously merely because tool can. A useful specification names focal point, message, entry/hold/exit, path, timing and review criteria.
workflow: Extract message/action; write beats; choose motion function; build timing/spacing plan; prototype full sequence; review clarity/comfort; refine tokens and exceptions.
mastery: Dapat memberi reason untuk tiap gerak, membuat choreography plan dan menilai full sequence sesuai tujuan.
advanced: Character acting; cinematography; montage; typography choreography; visual rhetoric; dance-inspired composition; procedural choreography; interactive narrative.

title: Accessibility Comfort and Adaptive Motion
purpose: Menjaga informasi dan task tetap dapat digunakan ketika motion dikurangi, dihentikan atau diganti, serta ketika device/context berbeda.
boundary: Accessibility bukan satu checkbox reduced motion. WCAG checks, user comfort, assistive technology dan contextual usability merupakan evidences berbeda.
topics: Reduced-motion preferences
System preference provides user intent but no-preference tidak membuktikan comfort. Adapt specific motion functions rather than remove semantic information.
Detect preference when platform supports; provide user setting where useful; respond changes.
CSS changed but JS still moves; essential info disappears.
Initial preference, live changes, all implementation paths.
Pause stop hide dan user control
Continuing movement can interfere reading/tasks. Applicable requirements depend content and trigger; user controls must work during animation.
Define controllable moving content, stop behavior, persistence and focus.
Pause button itself animates inaccessible; restart overwrites preference.
Keyboard operation and stop state across navigation/remount.
Flashing flicker dan motion sensitivity
Flashing and large visual self-motion have different concerns. Pixel-level metrics do not fully predict individual comfort.
Evaluate actual sequence with appropriate standard criteria; avoid inferred medical guarantees.
Reduced translation considered removes all flicker; still-frame audit.
Full sequence checks and actual preference/comfort feedback.
Keyboard focus dan assistive technology
Semantic visibility, focusability and announcement must match interaction state through motion. Visual offscreen isn't automatically inaccessible.
Manage focus, inert/hidden state as appropriate, avoid duplicates in transitions.
Hidden exit element remains focusable; changing DOM loses focus.
Keyboard traversal, screen-reader behavior and interrupted transitions.
Information alternatives
Motion can encode direction/progress/state. Provide meaningful text/static cues when movement unavailable or imperceptible.
Map each communicated fact to accessible alternative; maintain task completion.
Animation-only instructions or invisible status changes.
No-animation/no-sound paths with task-level verification.
Responsive capability adaptation
Viewport, input, performance and sensor support affect suitable motion. Adapt cost and layout while preserving user control.
Feature/capability detection, bounded quality tiers, baseline content.
Lower-end device removes essential state; media query overgeneralized device identity.
Small viewport, touch/no-hover, low capability and disconnect.
Evaluation and evidence boundaries
Automated audit and synthetic fixtures can verify limited technical properties, not full accessibility or comfort for everyone.
Record criterion, test setup, outcome and open human review.
Technical PASS promoted universal accessibility certification.
Manual interaction plus automated checks and representative users.
worked: Contoh navigation shared-element move becomes short opacity change or immediate state update under reduced-motion preference. Focus still moves to appropriate heading; loading state remains textually available. Preference change mid-animation cancels/retargets cleanly. Verify CSS, JS, Canvas and shader paths separately, because one media query cannot control all renderers.
workflow: Inventory motion functions/information; choose reduced alternatives; implement controls and semantic lifecycle; evaluate applicable criteria; test input/preferences; record human review limits.
mastery: Dapat membangun reduced-motion path tanpa kehilangan informasi dan menguji focus/controls selama interruptions.
advanced: Assistive technology testing; inclusive interaction; motion sensitivity research; caption/sound alternatives; user personalization; adaptive rendering; accessibility standards interpretation.

title: Runtime Scheduling and Performance Engineering
purpose: Menjalankan motion dengan response dan resource use sesuai target tanpa mengubah model atau task semantics diam-diam.
boundary: Performance target harus menyebut device/workload/refresh rate. Average FPS tidak membuktikan deadline, input latency, atau smoothness semua frames.
topics: Animation loop dan scheduling
Rendering clock and simulation clock berbeda. Browser callback timing bukan guaranteed fixed frequency. Work lifecycle menentukan apakah loop perlu aktif.
Use elapsed timestamps, fixed-step where needed, pause/offscreen policy.
New loop every interaction; hidden-tab stall integrated unbounded.
Single loop ownership, pause/resume, irregular frame times.
Frame budgets dan distributions
Budget 1000/refreshHz ms adalah interval theoretical, bukan seluruh CPU time available. Tail frame times sering menjelaskan jank lebih baik mean FPS.
Report median/p95/p99/max frame intervals with measurement setup.
Averaging hides isolated long stalls; CPU/GPU overlapped times summed incorrectly.
Representative interactions, load spikes, refresh variability.
Layout paint composite
DOM changes can trigger style/layout/paint/composite work. Effect cost depends geometry and engine, not property name alone.
Batch reads then writes; profile actual rendering pipeline.
Repeated layout reads after writes; huge blur layers.
Trace layout/paint events and compare controlled change.
CPU GPU memory dan transfer
Bottleneck dapat computation, bandwidth, submission, readback atau synchronization. Resource lifetime affects peaks/leaks.
Time stages with appropriate CPU/GPU instrumentation and memory accounting.
Async submission time claimed GPU execution.
Large/small workload sweeps and repeated resource churn.
Allocation garbage collection dan reuse
Frequent allocations can introduce pauses; pooling can retain excessive memory. Reuse chosen from measured behavior.
Preallocate bounded buffers; release ownership; avoid mutation conflicts.
Unbounded pools; reuse corrupts active data.
Allocation trace, peak memory, long session stability.
Workers batching caching dan quality tiers
Parallelism and batching add overhead and data-transfer constraints. Adaptive quality should preserve essential task information.
Move separable computation; batch updates; expose tier policy with hysteresis.
Quality oscillates each frame; worker output stale.
Low capability, transfer cost, tier transitions and stale data.
Profiling experiments dan regression
Optimize measured bottleneck, keeping correctness baseline. Benchmarks must record versions and environment.
Profile→hypothesis→controlled change→same workload compare.
Claimed faster from single run; changed scene invalidates comparison.
Repeat enough for variability, report distributions and correctness regression.
worked: Contoh 120Hz target has nominal 8.33ms presentation interval. A 7ms average CPU task does not guarantee fit: other work, GPU, input processing dan occasional 20ms allocations can miss frames. Measure representative distributions and identify which stage dominates. Reducing particles is a valid quality adaptation only if it preserves intended information and keeps transitions stable.
workflow: Define targets/environment; establish correctness baseline; instrument stages; profile representative workloads; optimize bottleneck; test memory/lifecycle; document quality policy.
mastery: Dapat melaporkan measured frame distributions, mendiagnosis layout/GPU/GC, dan menjaga behavior setelah optimization.
advanced: Real-time scheduling; browser pipelines; heterogeneous compute; performance modeling; energy/thermal constraints; memory allocators; scalable simulation; latency measurement.

title: Motion Software Architecture and Systems Engineering
purpose: Mengorganisasikan motion code dengan contracts, ownership, reproducibility dan integration boundaries yang dapat dipelihara.
boundary: Architecture mengikuti kebutuhan nyata; tidak semua prototype membutuhkan ECS/plugin framework. Engineering depth diukur dari correctness dan maintainability, bukan jumlah abstractions.
topics: Model behavior rendering separation
Motion models, interaction goals dan presentation depend berbeda. Separation memungkinkan headless testing and alternate renderers.
Input→intent/state→model evaluator→scene snapshot→renderer.
Renderer changes physics state; UI lifecycle owns global solver.
Headless model fixtures and alternate rendering adapters.
Ownership lifecycle dan resources
Transform, loop, listeners, buffers dan assets mempunyai owner dan lifetime. Shared ownership requires explicit reference/disposal rules.
Create/use/dispose contracts; property arbitration; immutable snapshots where practical.
Multiple writers, memory leak, disposed shared texture.
Repeated mounts/scenes, dispose idempotence and no post-dispose effects.
Entity component dan scene architecture
ECS suits many similar entities; scene graph suits hierarchy. Hybrid is possible with clear sync boundaries.
Choose data layout/query patterns; keep transform hierarchy consistent.
Premature ECS hides simple behavior; duplicate state systems diverge.
Scale workload and scene/physics consistency tests.
APIs plugins dan contracts
Extensions need typed/schema interfaces, units and versioning. Capability discovery determines what adapter really supports.
Validate inputs, name versions, document effects and errors.
Accept malformed data; plugin claims all formats.
Contract fixtures, incompatible versions and unsupported operation.
Deterministic evaluation replay dan snapshots
Reproducibility requires inputs, seed, clock semantics, versions and model parameters. Stateful simulations need checkpoints.
Record event log/snapshots; compare outputs under defined equivalence.
Seed-only reproducibility claim; hidden system clock dependencies.
Replay histories, checkpoint recovery, platform tolerance checks.
Error recovery dan degradation
Failures must preserve coherent task state. Visual failure should not silently change source truth.
Define recoverable errors, bounded retries, fallback renderer/motion, observability.
Infinite retries or quietly missing important content.
Resource load failure, device loss, invalid model state.
Integration documentation dan maintenance
Motion integrates routing, layout, assets, sensors and deployment. Changes need versioned contracts and migration guidance.
Record dependencies and rationale; update schema/examples together.
Library upgrade changes timing unnoticed.
Integration matrix and migration/regression fixtures.
worked: Contoh pure spring module advances {x,v} using dt/target/parameters; controller chooses target; renderer draws current x. Headless tests can compare analytic oracle without browser. UI teardown cancels loop/listeners but does not mutate historical simulation fixtures. A shared clock service prevents each component inventing incompatible time origins.
workflow: Identify modules/state owners; define contracts; implement minimal path; add adapters; test headless/integration; document lifecycle; version changes and migrations.
mastery: Dapat menjaga single ownership, headless correctness, replay dan bounded recovery; memilih architecture sesuai workload.
advanced: Data-oriented design; component systems; actor architecture; service boundaries; plugin ABI; observability; deterministic engines; fault-tolerant render systems.

title: Assets Data Models and Interoperability
purpose: Membawa motion data antartools/platform tanpa kehilangan units, hierarchy, timing, interpretation atau provenance.
boundary: Format support bukan jaminan fidelity. Importer/exporter perlu subset contracts dan round-trip checks; licenses/provenance tidak boleh ditebak.
topics: Asset identity dan provenance
Filename bukan immutable identity. Content hash, source, version dan license/usage record mendukung traceability.
Manifest records ID/path/hash/type/origin/version and actual license metadata.
Renamed asset mistaken new source; rights assumed from downloadable file.
Hash/file existence and provenance fields with unknowns explicit.
Coordinate units dan schemas
Asset format may define axes/units/rotation order berbeda. Conversion also impacts animation curves, normals and root motion.
Single normalized internal schema with reversible conversion metadata.
Only static mesh converted while clips remain old frame.
Known static and animated reference geometry round-trip.
Geometry rigs clips dan media
Geometry, skeleton, animation and audio have linked dependencies. Missing material/font/rig can change interpretation.
Validate referenced assets and compatibility before runtime.
Clip applied wrong skeleton; font replacement changes choreography.
Dependency closure, joint map and asset-loaded preview.
Formats import export dan feature subsets
Interchange formats support subsets different from authoring tools. Constraints/drivers may need bake; metadata may be dropped.
Document supported fields and unsupported features; bake at defined cadence.
Native rig controls assumed exported; successful file parse claimed full fidelity.
Known-feature fixture, bake comparison, unsupported-feature report.
Compression quantization dan streaming
Compression trade-off depends position/rotation/contact errors. Streaming introduces availability and scheduling constraints.
Choose per-channel quantization; progressive loading with explicit readiness state.
Root error accumulates, contact slip, stalls at chunk boundary.
Max interval errors, chunk transitions, loss/reconnect.
Versioning compatibility migration
Schema changes can reinterpret old data. Explicit versions and converters preserve history.
Read version, validate, migrate deterministically, record original.
Silent reinterpretation, missing default changes trajectory.
Old/new fixtures and round-trip migration expectations.
Lifecycle integrity dan inventory
Inventory validates actual bytes and metadata, not aesthetic suitability. Caches derived from source should be rebuildable.
Hash raw assets; validate formats; track derived outputs separately.
Metadata-only check claimed rendered content correct.
Corrupt/missing files, dependency mismatch, decode/render subset checks.
worked: Contoh import animation in centimeters with y-up into meters z-up. Apply scale/frame conversion consistently to mesh, skeleton translations, root trajectory and normals; rotations require basis conversion. Export, reimport and compare end-effector trajectories, not only static dimensions. If exporter omits constraints, bake evaluated transforms with documented sampling error.
workflow: Inventory source/provenance; inspect formats; normalize schemas/units; validate dependencies; import/render fixtures; export round-trip; record compression/migration limits.
mastery: Dapat membuktikan animated round-trip fidelity dan mendeteksi asset/reference mismatch tanpa mengklaim unsupported format features.
advanced: glTF/USD/FBX workflows; animation codecs; skeletal interchange; media metadata; font assets; content-addressed storage; schema evolution; streaming assets.

title: Authoring Tools and Production Pipelines
purpose: Membuat proses authoring, preview, baking, simulation dan rendering dapat diulang serta ditinjau dengan cepat.
boundary: Authoring interfaces mengubah data; runtime evaluator menentukan semantics. Pipeline otomatis perlu inspectable outputs dan failure propagation.
topics: Timeline curve dan node editors
Editors expose parameters and relationships. UI representation must match actual evaluation/interpolation.
Separate authoring data, UI state and evaluated state; preserve units/time.
Curve preview differs render; editor edits hidden duplicate state.
Edit/evaluate round-trip, undo/redo, segment boundaries.
Scripting automation dan batch authoring
Scripts can generate scenes/clips/assets repeatably. Inputs/config versions must recorded.
Parameterized idempotent generation with explicit output ownership.
Overwriting source assets, nondeterministic batch order.
Same-input reproducibility and dry/small fixtures.
Presets parameters dan reusable systems
Presets encode chosen defaults and valid ranges. Meaningful controls avoid exposing internals users cannot interpret.
Parameter schema, units, bounds, compatibility and exceptions.
Magic names conceal physics; invalid combinations crash.
Extremes, cross-parameter constraints and predictable edits.
Simulation cache dan baking
Bake turns stateful/complex evaluation into samples. Quality depends cadence/interpolation and which properties captured.
Record model/version/seed/time grid; preserve source setup separately.
Cache stale after parameter edit; no subframes for blur.
Hash invalidation, trajectory error versus live evaluation.
Preview iteration dan review
Cheap previews improve iteration but must disclose quality differences. Review notes need time/shot references.
Same semantics with lower-quality render where feasible; scoped review checklist.
Preview PASS taken final export PASS despite different pipeline.
Representative frames plus playback, final-specific checks.
Build render queues dan farms
Distributed production needs task IDs, retries and deterministic input bundles. Job completed is different from output verified.
Content-addressed inputs; bounded retries; verify outputs before publish.
Partial frames accepted; worker version mismatch.
Missing/corrupt outputs, retry idempotence and version audit.
Collaboration handoff dan provenance
Changes, approvals and creative rationale need durable records. Handoff includes state, artifacts, unresolved gaps and reproduction.
Version assets/config; retain review decisions with scope and dates.
Inherited status promoted current verification.
Reproduce from handoff, detect changed inputs, preserve open issues.
worked: Contoh procedural intro generator accepts text/theme/duration/fps. Generated timeline and renders have input hash and version. Preview uses lower resolution but identical timestamps. Final render verifies dimensions/count/PTS and separately reviews layout; preview approval alone is insufficient when font fallback or crop can differ at final settings.
workflow: Define input/output contracts; build parameterized authoring; generate preview; record review; bake/cache with fingerprints; render; validate; handoff reproducible bundle.
mastery: Dapat membuat repeatable authoring pipeline, cache invalidation dan reviewable outputs without conflating job success with quality.
advanced: Editor ergonomics; node graph tooling; render farms; pipeline orchestration; asset builds; collaborative editing; content versioning; reproducible media production.

title: Motion Testing Measurement and Quality Engineering
purpose: Menentukan apa yang benar-benar dibuktikan oleh numerical, structural, visual, temporal, performance dan human checks.
boundary: Tidak ada satu test yang membuktikan semua motion quality. Verifier dipilih per property dan hasilnya menyatakan scope/environment.
topics: Unit property dan model tests
Pure math/models dapat diuji dengan analytic oracle dan invariants. Tests harus mendeteksi meaningful error, bukan menyalin implementation.
Endpoint/invariant/property checks plus independent formula or solver.
Same bug in test and code; broad tolerances hide failures.
Mutation sanity checks and adversarial boundaries.
Numerical validation dan convergence
Error trajectory, residual dan conservation trends quantify solver properties. Physical validation membutuhkan external observations/model assumptions.
Compare refinement and independent reference; distinguish sources of error.
One timestep agreement claimed universal accuracy.
Whole trajectory, stiffness, discontinuity and conditioning cases.
Temporal visual dan interaction regression
Motion changes between frames, not just frames. Timing, path, lifecycle and input response need sequence tests.
Sample known times plus replay interactions; compare timestamps and semantic states.
Golden screenshot misses jump at unsampled time.
Continuous/denser checks around events and playback review.
Determinism compatibility dan replay
Repeated evaluation requires specified environment/versions/equivalence. Bit equality dan perceptual equivalence different guarantees.
Save seed/events/config; compare outputs with scoped tolerance/hash.
Platform differences ignored; uncontrolled clocks.
Repeated histories and actual target-platform matrix.
Performance memory dan stress
Quality under load includes latency, tail frames, memory and recovery. Stress fixture must have expected bounds, not just run long.
Record workload/environment/distributions/peak memory and lifecycle counts.
Only mean FPS; test machine mistaken all devices.
Dense scenes, mount loops, stalls, resource failure.
Accessibility usability dan perception
Automated checks cover subsets; human task/perception outcomes require participants and protocol.
Separate technical criterion results, manual review and human studies.
AI review called user testing; reduced motion called full conformance.
Keyboard/preferences, assistive tools, representative participants.
Instrumentation reporting dan uncertainty
Test reports capture inputs, methods, timestamps, result and limitations. Unknown remains unknown.
PASS tied property/environment; FAIL reproducer; NOT_RUN reason; measured versus inferred fields.
Entire repo marked verified from link checks.
Report completeness, provenance, and ability to reproduce failure.
worked: Contoh spring regression uses analytic critical-damping solution and tests timestep refinement. Browser drag test checks event cancellation/final state; screenshot test checks crop; profiler checks frame timing. These are four different results. Bundle them without claiming analytic spring test proves UX comfort or screenshot proves interruption correctness.
workflow: List required properties; choose independent verifiers; build fixtures; execute scoped tests; inspect visual/temporal outcomes; fix defects; write evidence and open gaps.
mastery: Dapat merancang tests yang membedakan numerical correctness, rendered content, runtime behavior dan human outcomes.
advanced: Metamorphic testing; property-based generators; perceptual metrics; hardware-in-loop; system identification validation; benchmark design; uncertainty quantification; reproducibility audits.

title: Media Delivery Encoding and Deployment
purpose: Menyampaikan motion sebagai media atau application yang benar cadence, format, metadata, behavior dan runtime target-nya.
boundary: Encoding success belum membuktikan decoded sequence benar. Deployment tidak sama publishing authorization; repository ini menyediakan knowledge dan examples, bukan layanan live.
topics: Frame sequences dan timestamp contracts
Input sequence filenames/indices, timestamps dan frame rate determine output timing. Audio sample count uses its own clock.
Define rational cadence, first PTS, frame count, nominal duration and gaps.
Missing frame silently held; 29.97 rounded incorrectly.
Expected frame list and decoded timestamp/count checks.
Codecs containers dan pixel formats
Codec encodes streams; container packages them. Chroma subsampling, bit depth, alpha and compatibility affect visuals.
Choose codec/pixel format according target; test actual playback support.
Alpha lost, odd dimensions unsupported, banding.
Decode output, inspect metadata and known color/alpha fixtures.
Audio video muxing dan sync
Stream timebases, encoder delay and trim offsets affect synchronization. Equal durations alone do not prove aligned events.
Preserve timestamps; define trim/pad policy; validate markers and drift.
Audio offset at start; resample rate metadata mismatch.
Beginning/middle/end markers and decoded stream lengths.
Resolution aspect color HDR metadata
Display aspect, sample aspect, primaries, transfer and range must match pipeline. Metadata tags do not turn SDR pixels into HDR.
Set source conversion and destination metadata consistently.
Stretched video, washed blacks, wrong transfer.
Native resolution/frame inspection and managed target playback.
Compression quality size dan streaming
Bitrate/quality trade-off depends motion/detail. Streaming segments add buffering and boundary constraints.
Evaluate target codec/settings across representative sequence and delivery bandwidth.
Static frame chosen bitrate; adaptive switch changes color/cadence.
Fast motion/detail, segment transitions, bandwidth impairment.
Application packaging deployment dan capabilities
Motion app must initialize assets, detect features, recover failure and support semantic baseline. Bundles/dependencies affect start latency.
Build reproducibly; version assets; inspect target capability fallback.
Works dev only; unavailable WebGPU hides all content.
Production bundle, offline/missing asset paths, target browser/device.
Final verification handoff dan maintenance
Release output must be compared expected contract and actual decoded/playback behavior. Retain inputs/scripts/versions for reproduction.
Decode full stream where relevant; verify PTS/count/dimensions; review sequence and log limitations.
File exists marked delivered; render job success replaces review.
Automated properties plus actual playback/manual review, distinguished.
worked: Contoh 120-frame sequence at 60fps has nominal coverage 2s. Encode into chosen container, then decode and count frames; inspect PTS rather than trusting filename/encoder log. If audio first cue at 0.5s, verify decoded marker alignment at start and end. Keep original frames/config if compressed export shows artifacts; output quality can be revised without rebuilding model.
workflow: Define delivery contract; choose codec/package; generate outputs; decode/validate properties; playback target; inspect sync/color; preserve reproduction/version; release with scoped evidence.
mastery: Dapat menghasilkan media dengan explicit timestamps, menjaga color/alpha/sync dan memverifikasi output melalui decode.
advanced: Adaptive streaming; media containers; video codecs; audio coding; HDR delivery; alpha codecs; app bundles; deployment compatibility; archival masters.
